autoCompleteNotReady: Available when all tops can reach the foundations
playing: Complete the eight foundations in suit (four up from the aces, four down from the kings)
selectionNoMoves: Selected card has no legal destination

tutorial.foundations: Eight foundations sit in the middle, seeded with one king and one ace of each suit. **The king row builds down, the ace row up**, in suit. All 104 cards wins.
tutorial.tableau: Twelve columns ring them. Only the top card moves, and it builds **up or down by rank ignoring suit**. **A king and an ace do not connect.** An empty column is never refilled.
tutorial.restriction: **On the first deal, where a column sits decides where it can send.** The top four reach the king row only, the bottom four the ace row only, and the four side columns either.
tutorial.redeal: Stuck? You get **two redeals**. Each gathers the columns from the last one and deals them out again without shuffling, so cards cross between columns. **The first redeal lifts the destination restriction.**
tutorial.controls: The footer buttons give you hints, auto-complete, undo, redeal and give up.

band.top: Top four - reach the king row only
band.bottom: Bottom four - reach the ace row only

restrictionsLifted: The destination restriction has been lifted
